summary.zh: 薄薄的岩石外衣，包着占很大比例的金属内部。这里一路看到中心；内核大小仍依赖模型。
summary.en: A thin rocky exterior surrounds a very large metallic interior. The journey reaches the center; inner-core size remains model-dependent.

evidence.zh: MESSENGER 的引力、磁场和水星自转数据支持大型金属核及液态部分；2019 年研究给出固体内核的测地学证据，不能把示意半径当精确测量。
evidence.en: MESSENGER gravity, magnetic and rotational measurements support a large metallic core with a liquid portion. A 2019 study found geodetic evidence for a solid inner core; the drawn radii are not measured dimensions.

kids.zh: 脚下先是被撞击坑和碎石覆盖的硬岩石。
kids.en: The first layer is hard rock covered with craters and broken material.

science.zh: 岩石地壳记录撞击与古老火山活动。真实地壳远薄于整颗水星，图中放厚以便辨认。
science.en: The crust records impacts and ancient volcanism. It is visually thickened to keep this thin layer identifiable.

kids.zh: 再往里还是岩石，不过比表面热得多。水星的岩石外衣比较薄。
kids.en: Deeper down is much hotter rock. Mercury has a relatively thin rocky exterior.

science.zh: 主要为硅酸盐岩石的地幔位于金属核外。把“热”画成颜色变化，不意味着地幔全是岩浆。
science.en: A silicate mantle surrounds the metallic core. Warm display colors do not mean the entire mantle is molten.

kids.zh: 这里有会流动的金属。水星虽小，金属内部却很大。
kids.en: Metal can flow here. Mercury is small, but its metallic interior is large.

science.zh: 引力与自转摆动约束支持部分熔融的富铁核。图中概括液态区，不解析可能的成分分层。
science.en: Gravity and libration constraints support a partly molten iron-rich core. This view does not resolve possible compositional sublayers.

kids.zh: 到了最中心。科学家从水星怎样转动、怎样拉住探测器，寻找这里是否坚硬的线索。
kids.en: At the center, scientists use Mercury’s rotation and pull on spacecraft to infer whether this material is solid.

science.zh: 2019 年对 MESSENGER 引力与自转的联合分析支持固体内核；其半径、轻元素比例仍有模型不确定性，没有直接拍到。
science.en: A 2019 joint gravity and rotation analysis supports a solid inner core. Radius and light-element content remain uncertain; there is no direct image.

sources.title: NASA · Mercury facts
NASA (2019) · Mercury spin, gravity and solid inner-core evidence

summary.zh: 云层下面有岩石地壳，更深处预计是地幔和富铁核；金星是否有固体内核还不能确定。
summary.en: Below the clouds are rocky crust, an inferred mantle and an iron-rich core. Whether Venus has a solid inner core remains unresolved.

evidence.zh: 雷达揭示表面，质量、引力和自转约束内部。没有像地球那样的全球地震观测，因此这里不把金星核分成已确定的固态、液态两圈。
evidence.en: Radar reveals the surface; mass, gravity and rotation constrain the interior. Without Earth-like global seismic observations, the core is not split into supposedly established solid and liquid shells.

kids.zh: 穿过厚厚的云，下面仍是坚硬的岩石地面，不是一片云做的地板。
kids.en: Under thick clouds lies hard rocky ground; the clouds themselves are not a floor.

science.zh: 此剖面从岩石表面开始，厚大气在外部景观中观察。雷达测得的火山和变形地貌支持岩石地壳。
science.en: The cutaway starts at the rocky surface; the thick atmosphere belongs to the exterior view. Radar-mapped volcanic and deformed terrain supports a rocky crust.

kids.zh: 这是厚厚的热岩石，可能极慢地变形，把里面的热带向外面。
kids.en: This thick hot rock can deform very slowly and carry heat outward.

science.zh: 质量和半径等约束支持硅酸盐地幔；热输运、黏度与分层依赖模型。地幔不是已确认的全球液态岩浆海。
science.en: Bulk constraints support a silicate mantle; heat transport, viscosity and stratification are model-dependent. It is not an established global liquid magma ocean.

kids.zh: 最里面可能有很大的金属核。它哪些地方是固体、哪些会流动，还需要更多线索。
kids.en: A large metallic core is inferred at the center. We still need better evidence about which parts are solid or liquid.

science.zh: 雷达自转测量给出转动惯量的粗约束，但核尺寸、轻元素含量与固液状态不能唯一反演。图中一整块核不表示它已确定全部为固体或液体。
science.en: Radar spin measurements constrain moment of inertia only roughly. Core size, light elements and phase are not uniquely determined; a single drawn region does not assert an entirely solid or liquid core.

sources.title: NASA · Venus facts
Margot et al. (2021) · Spin state and moment of inertia of Venus
Shah et al. · Interior structure models of Venus

summary.zh: 穿过薄地壳和主要为固体的热地幔，再经过液态外核，最后到达固态内核。海水只在表面盆地里，不包成厚厚一壳。
summary.en: Cross thin crust and a mostly solid hot mantle, then a liquid outer core and solid inner core. Seawater occupies surface basins, not a thick shell around the planet.

evidence.zh: 地震波的速度、反射、折射与缺失区，是区分地壳、地幔和固液核的重要证据；引力、矿物实验和磁场研究提供补充。人类没有钻到地心。
evidence.en: Seismic velocities, reflections, refractions and shadow zones distinguish crust, mantle and core phases, supplemented by gravity, mineral experiments and magnetic studies. No borehole reaches Earth’s center.

kids.zh: 大陆和海底都有岩石地壳。海水铺在低洼处，没有一直通向地心。
kids.en: Both continents and ocean floors have rocky crust. Water fills low basins; it does not continue to the center.

science.zh: 大陆地壳与大洋地壳厚度不同；这里合并为放大的薄壳。海洋不作为全球、等厚的内部层。
science.en: Continental and oceanic crust have different thicknesses; this enlarged shell combines them. The ocean is not a global uniform interior layer.

kids.zh: 岩石很热，大部分却没有化成水一样的液体；等很久，它能慢慢变形。
kids.en: The rock is hot but mostly solid. Over very long times it can slowly change shape.

science.zh: 上地幔主要是固体硅酸盐岩石，可发生缓慢固态流动，局部条件下部分熔融；软流圈不等于全球岩浆层。
science.en: The upper mantle is mostly solid silicate rock that can creep. Local partial melting does not make the asthenosphere a global magma layer.

kids.zh: 越往里，头顶压着的东西越多。这里仍主要是热而致密的固体岩石。
kids.en: More material presses down as we descend. This is still mainly hot, dense solid rock.

science.zh: 压力改变矿物晶体结构；下地幔的岩石以高压矿物形态存在，并在地质时间尺度参与对流。分层颜色不是实拍发光颜色。
science.en: Pressure changes mineral structures. High-pressure solid minerals participate in convection over geological times; layer colors are not photographed glow.

kids.zh: 这里不是岩浆，而是以铁为主、会流动的金属。
kids.en: This is flowing metal, mainly iron, rather than molten rock.

science.zh: 富铁液态合金构成外核；其导电流动与地磁场的发电机过程有关。剪切波不能像在固体中那样穿过液态外核。
science.en: The outer core is a liquid iron-rich alloy. Conducting motion contributes to the geodynamo; shear waves do not traverse it as they do a solid.

kids.zh: 终于到正中心了。这里很热，但挤压也非常强，金属仍能保持固体。
kids.en: At the very center it is extremely hot, but enormous pressure helps the metal remain solid.

science.zh: 地震学支持固态富铁内核。相态取决于温度、压力和成分的共同作用，不能只用“越热越液态”推断。
science.en: Seismology supports a solid iron-rich inner core. Phase depends jointly on temperature, pressure and composition, not temperature alone.

sources.title: NASA · Earth structure
USGS · Inside the Earth
USGS · The mantle is mostly solid rock

summary.zh: 红色表面下面是岩石地壳、地幔与液态金属核；2025 年地震研究还报告了中心固体内核的证据。
summary.en: Below the red exterior are crust, mantle and liquid metal. A 2025 seismic study also reported evidence for a solid inner core.

evidence.zh: InSight 的火星震记录与无线电跟踪约束内部。2025 年研究用核反射波等支持约 600 千米半径的固体内核；早先核模型有所不同，具体尺寸与成分仍需检验。
evidence.en: InSight marsquakes and radio tracking constrain the interior. A 2025 analysis of core-sensitive seismic phases supports an inner-core radius near 600 km; earlier core models differ, and dimensions and composition need further testing.

kids.zh: 红色尘土像很薄的外衣，下面是坚硬的岩石，并不是整颗火星都红得一样。
kids.en: Red dust is a thin coating over hard rock; the whole planet is not uniformly red inside.

science.zh: 表面铁的氧化物参与红色外观。地壳有横向变化，单站地震探测与引力测量约束其厚度，不是均一实心红球。
science.en: Iron oxides contribute to the red exterior. Seismology and gravity constrain a laterally varying crust rather than a uniform red sphere.

name.zh: 主要为固体的岩石地幔

kids.zh: 再往下是热岩石，不能把它全都当作正在流的岩浆。
kids.en: Deeper down is hot rock, not an entire ocean of flowing magma.

science.zh: InSight 约束地幔波速与结构。部分研究提出核上方有富集熔融硅酸盐层；这里不把该候选层或整片地幔一律画成液体。
science.en: InSight constrains mantle velocities and structure. Some studies propose a molten silicate layer above the core; this view does not label that candidate transition or the whole mantle uniformly liquid.

kids.zh: 岩石下面，来到以金属为主、能流动的一层。
kids.en: Under the rock is a mainly metallic layer that can flow.

science.zh: 穿核地震波与自转观测支持液态富铁合金，含有降低密度的轻元素。核边界会随采用的核上地幔模型而调整。
science.en: Core-sensitive seismic and rotational measurements support a liquid iron-rich alloy with lighter elements. The inferred boundary depends on the overlying mantle model.

kids.zh: 正中心可能藏着一小块固体金属。新的火星震线索正在帮我们看清它。
kids.en: The center appears to contain a small solid metal core. New marsquake clues help scientists investigate it.

science.zh: Bi 等 2025 年研究报告内核反射和穿核波相的证据，推断固体内核半径约 613 ± 67 千米。这里采用这一新解释，大小和组分并非直接测绘。
science.en: Bi et al. (2025) report inner-core reflected and core-traversing seismic phases, inferring a solid inner core of about 613 ± 67 km radius. This adopts that interpretation, not a direct interior map.

sources.title: NASA · InSight and the Martian mantle (2025)
Bi et al. (2025) · Seismic detection of a 600-km solid inner core in Mars
Le Maistre et al. (2023) · Spin state and deep interior structure of Mars

summary.zh: 从云层进入越来越稠密的氢氦流体，再到金属氢与逐渐混合的中心区。没有可以站稳的地面，也不把核心画成已确认的硬球。
summary.en: Clouds lead into denser hydrogen-helium fluid, metallic hydrogen and a gradually mixed central region. There is no landing floor or established sharply bounded solid core.

evidence.zh: Juno 的引力场与磁场观测结合高压物性模型支持深层结构；多个相容模型具有重元素向外混合的弥散核心，分界和成分不是直接拍到的。
evidence.en: Juno gravity and magnetic measurements, combined with high-pressure material models, constrain the interior. Compatible models include a dilute core with heavy material mixed outward; its boundaries are not photographed.

kids.zh: 条纹是云，不是地板。我们的起点只是云顶附近。
kids.en: The stripes are clouds, not floorboards. We begin near their tops.

science.zh: 外缘代表云顶附近的参考位置，不是固体半径边界；大气主要由氢和氦组成。
science.en: The outer edge is a near-cloud reference level, not a solid boundary. Hydrogen and helium dominate the atmosphere.

kids.zh: 往里走，周围越来越稠密，但没有突然踩到一层硬壳。
kids.en: Farther in, material becomes denser without suddenly turning into a hard floor.

science.zh: 压力与温度随深度增加，分子氢氦包层逐渐成为稠密流体；绘图区界限不是地面或普通海面。
science.en: Increasing pressure and temperature produce dense molecular fluid. Drawn region boundaries are neither ground nor an ordinary sea surface.

kids.zh: 这里的氢被压得很厉害，能像金属一样导电；它仍不是铁板。
kids.en: Hydrogen is compressed enough to conduct like a metal; it is not an iron plate.

science.zh: 高压下氢可进入导电的金属态流体。氦和重元素混合、相变范围及对流结构仍取决于内部模型。
science.en: High pressure permits conducting metallic hydrogen fluid. Helium and heavy-element mixing, transition breadth and convection remain model-dependent.

name.zh: 弥散核心：混合的重物质

kids.zh: 到中心了。较重的成分可能与周围的氢混在一起，不像果子里一颗边界整齐的核。
kids.en: At the center, heavier material may be mixed with hydrogen instead of forming one neatly outlined fruit stone.

science.zh: Juno 相容模型允许延展的重元素富集区，浓度向外渐变。此环只为定位，不代表刚性壳；是否另有小致密核心、其尺寸和状态仍不唯一。
science.en: Juno-compatible models allow an extended heavy-element enrichment with an outward gradient. This region is not a rigid shell; a possible compact central component and its size and state are not uniquely determined.

sources.title: NASA · Juno: the dilute or fuzzy core
NASA · Jupiter facts
Wahl et al. (2017) · Jupiter interior models and a dilute core

summary.zh: 云下面是高压流体和更重的混合物；“冰巨星”不是一颗包着可滑冰外壳的球。深处富水或富岩等模型仍有多种可能。
summary.en: Below the clouds lie high-pressure fluids and heavier mixtures. “Ice giant” does not mean an outer skating rink; both water-rich and rock-rich interior models remain possible.

evidence.zh: Voyager 2 的引力、磁场和遥感资料提供约束，但海王星只有很有限的近距离探测。2025 年内部模型仍允许差别很大的水岩比例，图中分区不是已测定的纯物质层。
evidence.en: Voyager 2 gravity, magnetic and remote-sensing data constrain Neptune, but close-up observations are limited. A 2025 model study still permits diverse water-to-rock ratios; these regions are not measured pure-material shells.

kids.zh: 先看见的是云和气体。外表蓝蓝的，不等于外面铺满海水。
kids.en: We first see clouds and gas. A blue exterior does not mean an exposed water ocean.

science.zh: 氢氦大气中少量甲烷影响光谱和颜色。剖面的外缘为大气参考层，不是固体地面。
science.en: Methane in a hydrogen-helium atmosphere affects the spectrum and color. The cutaway begins at an atmospheric reference level, not solid ground.

kids.zh: 往深处，气体的性质慢慢改变，挤成更稠密的流体。
kids.en: Deeper down, gas-like material gradually becomes a denser fluid.

science.zh: 氢氦与其他成分的比例随模型改变；外包层和内部混合区可能渐变，未发现可着陆的硬表面。
science.en: The hydrogen-helium fraction and other ingredients depend on the model. The transition can be gradual, without a landing surface.

kids.zh: 这里可能混着水、别的成分和岩石材料，温度压力都很高；不是我们能游泳的海。
kids.en: Water-bearing ingredients and rocky material may mix here under extreme heat and pressure; it is not a sea we could swim in.

science.zh: 传统模型使用富含水、氨和甲烷的高压物质；2025 年研究也容许富岩模型。高压相态与混合程度不唯一，不能把“冰”理解为日常冰块。
science.en: Traditional models use high-pressure water-, ammonia- and methane-bearing material; 2025 models also allow rock-rich interiors. Phases and mixing are uncertain; “ice” does not imply ordinary cold ice cubes.

kids.zh: 最中心可能更集中着较重的材料；具体混合成什么样，还在研究。
kids.en: Heavier material may be concentrated near the center; its detailed mixture is still being studied.

science.zh: 岩石和金属富集的中心区是一类模型表示，不保证有界限锐利、完全固态的小核。现有数据不能唯一确定尺寸、成分和温度。
science.en: A rock- and metal-enriched central region is one modeling representation, not a guarantee of a sharply bounded, fully solid small core. Size, composition and temperature are not uniquely fixed.

sources.title: NASA · Neptune facts
Morf and Helled (2025) · Icy or rocky? New interior models of Uranus and Neptune

summary.zh: 这是土星的卫星：表面局部有甲烷、乙烷湖，主体外层却是水冰。深处采用近熔高压冰的候选结构，全球地下水海洋还不能当成定论。
summary.en: This is Saturn’s moon: local methane-ethane lakes sit on an icy exterior. The deep view adopts a candidate near-melting high-pressure ice structure; a global subsurface water ocean is not treated as settled.

evidence.zh: Cassini 已观测表面湖海。2025 年对其潮汐引力响应的重新分析，挑战全球地下海洋解释，提出高压冰与液水囊模型；这与表面甲烷湖是两件事。
evidence.en: Cassini observed surface lakes and seas. A 2025 tidal-gravity reanalysis challenged a global subsurface ocean, proposing high-pressure ice with liquid-water pockets. This is separate from the observed surface hydrocarbon lakes.

kids.zh: 这里冷得让水变成硬冰；湖里的甲烷和乙烷却还能流。湖没有包满整颗卫星。
kids.en: Water freezes into hard ice here, while methane and ethane can flow in lakes. Those lakes do not cover the whole moon.

science.zh: 此剖面从冰质外壳起算。甲烷乙烷湖主要在极区，是局部表面液体，不能画成全球厚壳或与深处可能的液态水混同。
science.en: The radial view begins at the icy exterior. Mainly polar hydrocarbon lakes are local surface liquids, not a global thick shell or the same liquid as possible deep water.

name.zh: 高压冰与可能的液水囊
name.en: High-pressure ice and possible water pockets

kids.zh: 深处的冰被挤得很厉害，可能接近融化，夹着一些液态水；科学家仍在检查这个想法。
kids.en: Deep ice is strongly compressed and may be close to melting, with pockets of liquid water. Scientists are still testing this picture.

science.zh: Petricca 等 2025 年的潮汐耗散模型支持接近熔点的高压冰，允许局部熔融，而不是稳定的全球地下海。这里展示该候选模型，不宣称争论已全部结束。
science.en: Petricca et al. (2025) favor near-melting high-pressure ice with possible local melt rather than a stable global subsurface ocean. This is that candidate model, not a claim that every uncertainty is resolved.

kids.zh: 到了里面，可能有很多岩石。它不是一整颗铁球，也不是湖水一直通到中心。
kids.en: The interior is probably rich in rock, not one giant iron ball or lakewater extending all the way to the center.

science.zh: 引力与潮汐模型支持较低密度的岩石丰富核心，可能含水合矿物等组分；具体成分和分异程度仍不确定。
science.en: Gravity and tidal models support a relatively low-density rock-rich core, potentially including hydrated minerals. Detailed composition and differentiation remain uncertain.

sources.title: NASA · Titan facts and observed surface lakes
NASA (2025) · Titan may not have a global subsurface ocean
Petricca et al. (2025) · Titan tidal dissipation and an ocean-free interior model

summary.zh: 巨蟹座 55 e 很靠近恒星，白昼侧可能有熔融岩石。本剖面只是从热表层到中心的一种候选结构，任何边界都不是已测得的岩浆海底。
summary.en: 55 Cancri e orbits close to its star and may have dayside molten rock. This cutaway is one candidate arrangement down to the center; no boundary is a measured magma-ocean floor.

evidence.zh: 质量、半径、热辐射与 Webb 光谱约束整体和可能的大气，不能像地震扫描一样解析内部。熔融深度、地幔成分、金属核的存在细节与尺寸仍未确定。
evidence.en: Mass, radius, thermal emission and Webb spectra constrain the bulk planet and possible atmosphere, not a seismic image of its interior. Melt depth, mantle composition and the details and size of any metallic core remain unresolved.

name.zh: 高温表层（昼侧可能熔融）

kids.zh: 朝着恒星的一面，岩石可能热得会流动；背面的情况可能不同。我们还没有这里的实拍照片。
kids.en: On the star-facing side, rock may become hot enough to flow. The far side can differ, and we have no photograph of this surface.

science.zh: 热与光谱观测支持岩浆海解释，但未测得其范围或深度。径向色带便于讲解，不表示全球等厚熔融壳；底边不能读成已知海底。
science.en: Thermal and spectral data motivate a magma-ocean interpretation without measuring its extent or depth. A radial color band is not a globally uniform molten shell; its lower edge is not a known sea floor.

kids.zh: 再往里面，画的是可能存在的岩石材料；它们多少熔化、怎样混合，还不知道。
kids.en: Farther in, we illustrate possible rocky material. How much is molten and how it mixes are still unknown.

science.zh: 硅酸盐地幔是岩石行星内部的一类模型选择；大气、热状态与组成可产生简并，不能从质量和半径唯一确定这一层。
science.en: A silicate mantle is one rocky-interior model choice. Atmospheric, thermal and compositional degeneracies prevent a unique inference from mass and radius.

kids.zh: 画面可以一直走到中心，但走到的只是一个可能模型；科学家并没有真的看见这里的金属核。
kids.en: Our picture reaches the center, but it is still a possible model. Scientists have not directly seen a metallic core here.

science.zh: 集中金属核只是候选方案；核的大小、成分、固液状态乃至分层方式都未被唯一确定。不能把到达图中中心当作证明这颗行星与地球内部相同。
science.en: A concentrated metallic core is a candidate, not a unique result. Its size, composition, phase and segregation remain unresolved; reaching the drawn center does not establish an Earth-like interior.
